identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of QLS31905 and/or QL1706 Combination With Chemotherapy in the Advanced Malignant Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of QLS31905 and/or QL1706 Combination Chemotherapy for the Treatment of CLDN18.2-Positive Advanced Malignant Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of QLS31905 and/or QL1706 plus chemotherapy in patients with Claudin18.2-positive advanced solid tumors.

armGroups.label: QLS31905 + oxaliplatin + capecitabine
armGroups.description: Gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer participants will be treated with QLS31905 at doses determined by the phase I study in combination with oxaliplatin and capecitabine.

armGroups.label: QL1706 + oxaliplatin + capecitabine
armGroups.description: Gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer participants will be treated with QL1706 in combination with oxaliplatin and capecitabine.

armGroups.label: QLS31905 + oxaliplatin + capecitabine + QL1706
armGroups.description: Gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer participants will be treated with QLS31905 at doses determined by the phase I study in combination with oxaliplatin and capecitabine+ QL1706.

armGroups.label: QLS31905 + gemcitabine+cisplatin
armGroups.description: Biliary tract cancer will be treated with QLS31905 at doses determined by the phase I study in combination with gemcitabine and cisplatin.

armGroups.label: QL1706 + gemcitabine+cisplatin
armGroups.description: Biliary tract cancer will be treated with QL1706 in combination with gemcitabine and cisplatin.

armGroups.label: QLS31905 + gemcitabine+cisplatin+ QL1706
armGroups.description: Biliary tract cancer will be treated with QLS31905 at doses determined by the phase I study in combination with gemcitabine and cisplatin+ QL1706.

armGroups.label: QLS31905 + standard chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Other solid tumor participants will be treated with QLS31905 at doses determined by the phase I study in combination with standard chemotherapy recommended by guidelines.

armGroups.label: QL1706 + standard chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Other solid tumor participants will be treated with QL1706 in combination with standard chemotherapy recommended by guidelines.

armGroups.label: QLS31905 + standard chemotherapy + QL1706
armGroups.description: Other solid tumor participants will be treated with QLS31905 at doses determined by the phase I study in combination with standard chemotherapy and QL1706.

interventions.name: Oxaliplatin
interventions.description: 130 mg/m2, intravenous infusion, D1, up to 8 cycles.

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: 1000 mg/m2 administered as IV infusion on D1/D8 of each cycle.

interventions.name: Cisplatin
interventions.description: 25 mg/m2, intravenous infusion, D1/D8, up to 8 cycles.

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the proportion of participants who have a best overall response of Complete Response (CR) or Partial Response (PR)

secondaryOutcomes.description: An AE is any untoward medical occurrence in a subject, temporally associated with the use of a medicinal product, whether or not considered related to the medicinal product. An AE can therefore be any unfavorable and unintended sign (including an abnormal laboratory finding), symptom,or disease (new or exacerbated) temporally associated with the use of a medicinal product.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety assessed by incidence of serious adverse events (SAE)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Adverse Event (AE) is considered "serious" if the investigator or sponsor view any of the following outcomes: Death, life-threatening, persistent or significant disability/incapacity, congenital anomaly or birth defect,hospitalization, or medically important event.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with laboratory value abnormalities
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with potentially clinically significant laboratory values.
DOR is defined as the time from the date of the first response (CR/PR) until the date of radiological progressive disease or death due to any cause (whichever occurs first).

PFS is defined as the duration from the subject's first dose of the investigational product to the first imaging confirmation of radiological progressive disease or death due to any cause (whichever occurs first).
OS is defined as the duration from the first dose of the investigational product to the time point when death occurs due to any cause.
Cmax will be derived from the PK serum samples collected.
Tmax will be derived from the PK serum samples collected.
T1/2 will be derived from the PK serum samples collected.
CL will be derived from the PK serum samples collected.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Apparent volume of distribution during the terminal phase (Vz)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Vz will be derived from the PK serum samples collected.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of anti-drug antibody (ADA) Positive Participants
secondaryOutcomes.description: Immunogenicity will be measured by the number of participants that are ADA positive.
